confidence_notes: Holistic estimate for July 2026, peak tourist season. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately confident; accommodation anchors are less certain and assume high-season pricing. Edinburgh's visitor levy (about 5% of accommodation cost, if in force for these stays) may not be fully reflected in the hotel and hostel figures. The FX observation is the RBA homepage figure for 15 October 2026, read from search-result text, not confirmed against the RBA daily table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of UK city pricing, scaled from GBP to USD at roughly 1.33 USD per GBP and benchmarked against comparable mid-sized Northern European historic tourist cities with similar high-season demand.
